settings.editor: Innovive manufactures pre-filled water bottles for mouse and rat IVC systems using a controlled multi-step water processing system. Each bottle arrives tested, labeled, and double-bagged, so your facility never has to manage in-house water preparation, acidification, or quality verification.

settings.title: The Hidden Overhead of DIY Vivarium Water

settings.editor: Many research facilities still fill, acidify, and test water bottles in-house. It is time-consuming, introduces variability, and requires dedicated staff, equipment, and quality control processes. When something goes wrong with pH, contamination, or batch records, the consequences reach your animals and your studies.

Outsourcing water production to Innovive removes that overhead entirely. Your team receives bottles that are already filled, tested, acidified to spec, and packaged for immediate use. No prep. No testing. No batch records to maintain internally.
The Innovive water processing system produces water that meets research-grade standards on every batch, verified before it ships

settings.title: A Controlled Process, Start to Finish

settings.editor: Aquavive water is produced inside a positive-pressure HEPA-filtered environment using an automated conveyor system that fills, caps, dates, and labels each bottle. Every batch goes through a multi-step quality verification process before leaving our facility.

icon_list.text: Acidified water (pH 2.5 to 3.0, to prevent bacterial disease transmission between rodents)
Acidification (pH) testing to confirm precise acidification range
ATP testing on bottles, caps, conveyor belts, and filling systems using luminometry, with a standard of 10 RLU or less
Point-of-use testing with bioburden measurement, targeting less than 0.1 CFU/ml and less than 500 ppb Total Organic Carbon (TOC)
Additional testing for HPC, mold, coliform, yeast, and trihalomethanes (THMs in chlorinated water)

settings.editor: Every bottle is date- and lot-stamped, allowing full traceability back to the batch test results.

Filled Aquavive bottles are vacuum-sealed in an inner bag and enclosed in a secondary containment outer bag before shipping. The double-bag system maintains sterility in transit and through storage, consistent with the same Research-Ready standard applied to Innovive's disposable caging.
When your team opens a bottle, the water inside has been processed, tested, and sealed in a controlled environment. You do not need to verify it. We already did.

settings.editor:
